title: One home for spawning a daemon in the test tree
objective: Collapse the invented launcher into a single harness type that owns spawn, lifeline and reap, so the lifeline cannot be forgotten at a new call site.
body: **THIS IS THE HIGHLANDER HALF.** Shipped code has zero spawn sites for `intentd`; the test tree has dozens. A fix applied at one of them is a fix at one of them. The harness type is where the lifeline is attached, and a check refuses a second spawn site so the count cannot silently grow back.
